x: Holden, of Cambridge, was first home, followed by Chas. Walker, with Cass, of Cambridge, third. Then followed Bob Taylor, Denis Brickwood and J.

The race was now developing into one of the best of the series, Major was determined to keep the Bels within striking distance by moving us up to 3rd. Collins held on to the lead for Hercules/W'don and young Cass ran a good 4¾ miles for Portsmouth.
…rshot, Portsmouth and Cambridge were all within striking distance). Laurie rose to the occasion in great style and only Cass of Portsmouth was faster on this stage.…
